I teach mathematics and statistics at UA Little Rock and direct the **Math
Assistance Center (MAC)**. My teaching emphasizes:

- conceptual understanding over rote procedure,
- early exposure to Bayesian ideas in introductory statistics,
- and reproducible workflows using R, LaTeX, and (carefully) AI tools.

## Current courses

### [Intro to Mathematical Software](/math-software/)
A hands-on tour of R, LaTeX, Git, and AI-assisted workflows for math and
stats students.

### [Intro to Statistics](/intro-stats/)
A first course in statistical reasoning. Concepts, simulation, and small
reproducible R examples.

### Applied Statistics I
A graduate-level applied statistics course. This course currently runs
through Blackboard and does not have a public site.

## Math Assistance Center

I direct the MAC at UA Little Rock — a drop-in support center that pairs
trained peer tutors with students in lower-division mathematics and
statistics courses.
